name: Curve LlamaLend
fix_description: The root cause is that Curve LlamaLend liquidation mechanism is incompatible with atomically-changable oracles. The attacker donates to sDOLA to atomically inflate its share price (totalAssets uses balanceOf), which paradoxically triggers liquidations on LlamaLend. Fix: use TWAP or time-delayed oracle for sDOLA pricing in LlamaLend, or add donation resistance (internal accounting instead of balanceOf) in totalAssets.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC chains nested flash loans, multiple Curve/LLAMMA/Yearn/sDOLA interactions, controller loan creation/repayment, liquidation of protocol users via a helper contract, and state-sensitive accounting manipulation. Writing it requires deep understanding of LlamaLend/LLAMMA and several external protocols, with many coordinated steps and non-obvious sequencing well beyond a straightforward exploit.
